notes.title: 1.0 UPDATE!!!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Here comes the great 1.0 update to finalize Castle of Alchemists Early Access period!!

Thank you people for sticking with us through this 6-month-planned-actually-took-22-months-23-days journey!

Here are the patch note:[/b][/h3]


[h1]CASTLE OF ALCHEMISTS 1.0 PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[h2]TECHNICAL [/h2]
Since we have revamped a lot of systems at the background and the progression, you will require a brand new save.

[h2]Cloud Saves[/h2]
Game now supports cloud saves, tested on Steam Deck too.


[h2]NEW ENEMY FACTION : DRUIDS![/h2]

We finalize our enemy line up with earth themed faction, druids, with [b]13 new monsters[/b].

[h3]NEW BOSSES : BALOR & YMIR![/h3]

New faction comes with its new boss, [b]Balor the Evil Eye[/b] with its heavy ranged attacks and summons across the arena.

And Arctic Faction finally gets its boss, [b]Ymir, Lord of Jotun[/b], raining down ice and bringing pain with its fists!


[h2]NEW LEVELS[/h2]

We are adding 4 completely new levels :
[list]
[*] Crystal Mines, populated by Druids.
[*] South Warehouse, populated by Druids and Arctics.
[*] Old Mines, populated by Druids.
[*] Crossroads, populated by all the factions coming at once, final doorstep before Ymir!
[/list]

We have also added 2 new endless maps for West Warehouse and Crossroads.

Finally, 2 more boss arenas, for Balor and Ymir.

All the unlock progression has been revamped through new levels with new challenges. Mine tilesets are now populated by Druid factions alone.

[h2]ENEMY POWERUP: DEBUFFS[/h2]
Enemies now can apply certain debuffs to Bellator as follows:

[list]
[*] Impairment : Heavily reduces vision of Bellator.
[*] Weakness : Reduces weapon damage of Bellator by 50%.
[*] Blaze : Burns and deals 20 damage per second to Bellator, bypassing absorption.
[*] Frostbite : Reduces movement speed and increases stamina consumption by 50%.
[*] Curse : Increases the damage Bellator takes by 50%.
[/list]

Some of the existing enemies are modified to apply these debuffs as well as new ones.


[h2]XP & SKILL REVAMPS[/h2]

XP progression system has been revamped to make it more clear. It starts with 1000 xp requirement at level 3, and increases on certain intervals by 500 points at 11th and 21th levels making them 1500 XP and 2000 XP per level. 

All regular challenges now give extra 75 XP.
All difficult challenges now give extra 150 XP.

[h2]Revamped Skills[/h2]
Majority of the skill are revamped with their Level 5 Mutation and Advanced Trainings.

[list]
[*] Eyes Mutation : Reduces the effects and  duration of Impairment on Bellator by 50 percent.
[*] Bones : Grants 4 damage absorption per level.
[*] Bones Mutation : Reduces the effects and  duration of Frostbite on Bellator by 50 percent.
[*] Lung Capacity : Increases Stamina by 10 percent per level.
[*] Lung Capacity Mutation : Reduces the effects and  duration of Weakness on Bellator by 50 percent.
[*] Reflexes : Increases Dodge chance by 8 percent per level.
[*] Reflexes Mutation : Reduces the duration of Blaze on Bellator by 50 percent.
[*] Muscle Density Mutation : Reducing your weight increases your Melee Damage, up 50 percent at half weight.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Vial Training : Reduces cooldown 7 percent per level.
[*] Clockwork Training : Increases duration 10 percent per level.
[*] Turret Training : Increases radius by 10 percent per level.
[*] Booby Trap Training : Increases damage by 10 percent per level.
[*] Booby Trap Advanced Training : You longer play an animation while deploying booby traps.
[*] Alchemical Training : Increases elemental damage of weapons by 10 percent per level.
[*] Alchemical Advanced Training : Dealing elemental damage with weapon grants 1 charge. At 10 charge, an elemental explosion occurs on the enemy same as the weapon element.
[*] Mechanical Training : Increases physical damage of weapons by 10 percent per level.
[*] Mechanical Advanced Training : Reduces your active cooldowns by 0.5 second per critical strike.
[*] Melee Weapon Training : Reduces stamina cost of the melee weapons by 10 percent per rank.
[*] Melee Weapon Advanced Training : Killing enemies in melee increases melee damage by 5 percent, stacks up to 5 times seperately.
[*] Ranged Weapon Training : Increases crit chance of the ranged weapons by flat 2 percent per rank.
[/list]


Aside from these we made numerous small changes for both QoL, backend systems and more.

Hope you enjoy!

Cheers!

notes.title: vEA_09 - SULTAN UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello good folk!

Here comes our new boss for Flame Faction, Grinning Sultan, 9 new traps and lots of item reworks!

Here are the patch notes:

[h1]NEW BOSS : GRINNING SULTAN[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/e539a266cbd4e5037152c14eaf4ca2619368b924.gif[/img]

Our second boss has been added to the game, [b]Grinning Sultan[/b], leading the flame faction. You can reach him after Magma Reserves and defeating him is required to unlock 3rd scroll if you haven't already.

[h1]NEW ENEMIES[/h1]
[h2]Ice Faction Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new enemy, [b]Arctic Jotun Warlord[/b]. Armored version of the Jotun with a devastating area of effect ice attack.
[/list]

[h1]NEW LEVELS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new level to the 2nd scroll, [b]Iron Mines[/b], as a branch for Blacksmith Wings. 
[*] Added a new level to the 2nd scroll, [b]Magma Chambers[/b], as the arena of the new boss.
[/list]

[h1]NEW TRAPS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/27faa8e993dc28d12823813c84b1c61cf78e4166.gif[/img]
[h2]Trap Bases[/h2]
[list]
[*] Brand new trap type, [b]Impaler Trap[/b], has been added to the game. Hits a single enemy for massive damage, if it kills a non-heavy unit, its corpse is impaled on the trap. After a brief moment, it fills the corpse with chemicals and primes itself. Default version explodes the corpse dealing massive damage around with pieces of it.
[*] Brand new trap type, [b]Peg Top Trap[/b], has been added to the game. It is a ceiling trap, releasing a giant peg top, which can bounce off the walls. Default version releases a knocking peg top, which pushes enemies back with each hit and can bounce more than other versions.
[/list]
[h2]Variant Traps[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Impaler - Poison[/b], variant for Impaler trap. Fills the corpse with toxic fumes, when primed explodes the corpse, releasing poisonous gasses.
[*] [b]Impaler - Marking[/b], variant for Impaler trap. Fills the corpse with fluids which increases the blood viscosity, when primed explodes the corpse, applying Marked condition in a large area. 
[*] [b]Peg Top Trap - Blades[/b], variant for Peg Top trap. Giant peg top applies bleed as it passes through enemies.
[*] [b]Peg Top Trap - Dynamo[/b], variant for Peg Top trap. Giant peg top that gains electri charge as it gains momentum, and shocks nearby enemies.
[*] [b]Cannon Shooter[/b], variant for Shooter Trap. A giant cannon with a trigger area further from the trap. Bombards the area when triggered.
[*] [b]Iron Fist,[/b] variant for Mechanical Ceiling Trap. A giant iron fist, pounds the ground with extreme force, dealing massive damage directly below and applies Slow condition to enemies in large area.
[*] [b]Cyro Bellows[/b], variant for Furnace Trap. Instead of burning enemies, it applies heavy chill to them. 
[/list]

[h1]NEW CANNONS & CONSUMABLES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new shoulder cannon, [b]Gatherer Shot[/b]. Gathers enemies in front of you and stuns them.
[*] Added a new shoulder cannon, [b]Toxic Blast[/b]. A heavy blast that deals acid damage, leaves acid puddles and poison clouds behind.
[*] Added a new consumable, [b]Focus Pellets[/b]. Consuming one allows you to crit every ranged hit for 8 seconds.
[*] Added a new consumable, [b]Iron Skin Syringe[/b]. Using one grants damage reduction, fast healing and immunity to poise break for 20 seconds.
[/list]

[h1]ITEM REWORKS[/h1]
[h2]Alchemical Greatsword[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/b6c5ac6d205b00ff14f593320d224e99b336a946.gif[/img]
All of the versions have been reworked:
[list]
[*] [b]Alchemical Greatsword Poison[/b], has been reworked to apply Poison all the time for 2 seconds. When charge is activated, it applies Poison for 8 seconds and leaves behind small poison clouds with each swing.
[*] [b]Alchemical Greatsword Corrade[/b], has been reworked to apply Corrade all the time for 2 seconds. When charge is activated, it applies Corrade for 8 seconds and leaves behind small acid puddles with each swing.
[*] [b]Alchemical Greatsword Frost[/b], has been reworked to apply Chill all the time for 2 seconds. When charge is activated, it applies Chill for 8 seconds.
[*] [b]Alchemical Greatsword Marking[/b], has been reworked into [b]Slayer Sword[/b]. It has now very strong physical stats with an increased weight. When charge is activated, it drains health by 35 per second but increases the damage it deals by 50%.
[/list]
[h2]Spider Clockwork[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Spider Clockwork Acid[/b] has been rework to work like shooter turret. It targets the furthest enemy within range. While it travels towards to target, it deals acid damage around. When it reaches target and explodes, applies Corrade to enemies.
[*] [b]Spider Clockwork Oil[/b] has been rework to work like shooter turret. It targets the furthest enemy within range. While it travels towards to target, it applies Oiled to enemies. When it reaches target and explodes, leaves behind an oil puddle.
[/list]
[h2]Shooter Turret[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Shooter Turret Piercing[/b] has been reworked into [b]Shooting Turret Saws[/b]. Now it sends out saws that travels on the ground till it hits  a wall. See the saw rework below.
[/list]
[h2]Core Hammer[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Furnace Hammer[/b]'s final hit while its charge is active now sends out flames that deals damage and can ignite flammables.
[/list]
[h2]Shoulder Cannons[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Heavy Blast[/b] cooldown has been reduced from 90 seconds to 60 seconds.
[*] [b]Freezing Blast[/b] cooldown has been reduced from 60 seconds to 45 seconds.
[/list]
[h1]SKILL REWORKS[/h1]
This is the first touch on the skill we have made for a long time, expect more to come.
[list]
[*] [b]Tough Skin[/b]'s level 5 mutation has been reworked. Previously it granted damage reduction on certain conditions. Now it directly increases the number of consumables you can use by 2.
[/list]

[h1]CONDITON REWORKS[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Poison[/b] condition now doubles the effects of bleed.
[*] [b]Bleed[/b] condition now deals damage according to movespeed of the enemy, while they move. You can apply multiple stacks of Bleed, up to 5. Applying Bleed refreshes the duration for all stacks.
[*] [b]Saws[/b] that travel on the ground now apply Bleed condition. This works for Saw Shooter Trap, Shooter Turret Saws & Mechanical Trap Saws. It does not work for Saw Trap and its variants.
[*] [b]Marked[/b] condition now effects turrets too. 
[*] [b]Wet[/b] condition now amplifies the applied Chill by 100 percent rather than immediately freezing chilled enemies. 
[*] [b]Caltrops[/b] no longer applies Bleed, only Slow.
[/list]

[h1]QoL OPTIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] We have added a new option to both main menu and pause menu, [b]Aimed Camera[/b]. You can now toggle between the current aim system where the camera moves towards your aim in combat mode, or a static one where the camera is fixed to keep Bellator at the center.

This has been request to reduce the amount of motion sickness. We are still working on that.
[/list]

This will be all for this patch notes. Patch will go online for both main game and prologue version.
[b]As we mentioned in earlier updates, localization for new updates are not present yet.[/b]

Don't forget to join our discord channel or post on our discussions if you have any feedback!

Cheers !

notes.title: vEA_08d - Gauntlet Update
notes.notes:
With this update we are bringing a brand new melee weapon, a pair of fast-hitting power gauntlets!

[h1]New Melee Weapon - Power Gauntlets[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/ca2a8a3937c0759646b6ecd5912dbf02bba97218.gif[/img]

A fast hitting weapon with a 7 hit combo.

Gathers charge by hitting enemies. You can spend gathered charge for alternative attacks. Variants as follows:
[list]
[*]Power Gauntlets - Quake
Alternative hits pounds the ground, dealing damage in a large radius. Each hit requires 25% charge, and can be alternated withouth breaking your attack combo.

[*]Power Gauntlets - Smash
Alternative hits smashes the ground, slowing enemies in a large radius for 10 seconds at 50% charge, stunning them at 100% charge.

[*]Power Gauntlets - Haymaker
At 100% charge, alternative hit kills the first non-heavy enemy it connects, sending its corpse flying back damaging any enemy it hits for 350 physical damage.
[/list]
Power Gauntlets unlocks after you beat Magma Reserves. If you already beat it, it comes already unlocked on the craft screen.

[h1]Quality of Life Updates[/h1]

[*] All Crank Gun versions now go into reload when you hold down the attack button and have no steam pressure (ammo) left. Meaning, you can hold down the attack button and you will attack-reload without interruption.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Frozen Kills not registering properly has been fixed.
[*] Team Machiavelli intro video sound now is tied to Music Volume slider.
[*] On Hop Cluster bombs not working for Repeater Crossbow has been fixed.
[/list]

Update will go through for both main game and prologue. 
That will be all for this patch now. 

Cheers!

Hello good folk!

We are bringing traps, balance and QoL changes.

We reworked the Ceiling Acid Trap and brought its variants in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/c61e68b6c8fa4735cd62da1839cac71c67daa35a.gif[/img]

Cheers!

notes.title: vEA_08 - BOSS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello good folk!

We have added our first boss to the game alongside other 7 new enemies to spice up the enemy line-up, as well as bringing 2 new maps, balance changes and a whole new difficulty mode.

With this update, we will also be releasing a "prologue" version of the game, consisting 4 levels and an endless level.

[b][u]As an important note, since we made a lot of structural changes, this update will require you to start a fresh new game.[/u][/b]

Here are the patch notes:

[h1]BOSS BATTLE[/h1]

We have added our first boss battle to the game, Gate Keeper Golem. You will fight with it at the end of the first scroll. 

Unlike other levels, in boss battle you will only fight against a single boss with special abilities. Theboss will not try to escape but will try to kill you with its abilities. 

You will have a preparation period for laying traps as usual. You will have 3 lives to beat the boss on Regular Mode and a single life in Difficulty Mode (mentioned below). 

We decided to depend on Action-RPG mechanics for boss battles more than tower defense elements of the game. We hope that you enjoy it and we will improve it with your feedback.

[h1]DIFFICULTY MOD[/h1]

notes.title: Dev Log Update
notes.notes:
We wanted to update you on what we have been working on for Castle of Alchemists since our last update.

[h2]First things first: "Difficulty Mode"![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/aef6211ad6ecef80663dd1e3f5a084ff91857d45.gif[/img]

You will be able to select a more "challenging" version of the map from the Warroom with a single toggle. In this mode, enemy wave composition will change, enemy aggression will increase, your building resources will decrease, and you will receive more rewards for completion.

This will allow us to balance levels for new players while keeping the challenging nature of the game for players who are looking for more action.

Initially, this mode will only increase your regular rewards by around 25%. In the future, each level will have separate stats for difficulty mode as well as additional challenges and rewards.

[h2]Secondly, new enemies to spice things up.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/c5a25a4fc564aa0cd34405fb7f69ba2d6fcaa558.gif[/img]

We are adding several new enemies, ranging from summoners to fast riders with different behaviors, to each faction to bolster their ranks. This also helps us balance the levels for normal and difficulty modes.

With these new enemies, we will also introduce a new form of buff: permanent auras.

For example, the "Slave Giant" will make his allies near him "immune to chill" to cover the inherent weakness to chill for the Flame Faction. We will experiment with more of these with the upcoming enemies too.

[h2]Last but not least, new traps![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/d567904b0a2e06fe64a6e82c25c8081bbefd1d48.gif[/img]

We are aware that we are lacking in the department of traps, especially heavy-hitting ones. Expect to see pendulums, explosive barrels that you can launch with melee attacks, and more with the upcoming patch. With future patches, we will quickly fill our ranks of traps with your feedback!

We will keep you updated with more devlogs from now on, releasing them on a weekly basis!

Stay tuned for the new patch, coming very soon.

Cheers!

notes.title: CRAFT EXPANSION UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello good folk!

We have updated our crafting system for weapons, with new abilities and conditions and brought several UI/UX updates and reworks to some existing systems.

Here are the patch notes: 

[h1]REWORKS[/h1]
We have reworked some of the mechanics for a better experience.
[list]
[*][h3]Poison Clouds[/h3]
Now coloured green. Explodes when contacted with fire.
[*][h3]Heavy Poison[/h3]
Works exactly like Poison. We kept this in the game for prevent corrupted save files. Will be removed in future updates.
[*][h3]Explosive Gas[/h3]
Increased its damage to distinguish from poison clouds.
[*][h3]Acid Puddles[/h3]
Now deals acid damage to enemies passing. Hitting an acid puddle with electricity releases a 3x3 Poison Cloud.
[*][h3]Hydro Puddles[/h3]
No longer applies wet, still conducts electricity. When hit by chill, freezes and no longer conducts but slows enemies instead.
[*][h3]Sprinkler Trap[/h3]
No longer slows. Instead applies a condition to enemies within radius for its active duration (10 seconds) and leaves a 3x3 puddle on the ground. Variants as follows
[list]
[*] Default : Sprinkler Trap - Oil => Applies Oiled to enemies and leaves an Oil Puddle.
[*] Upgrade 1: Sprinkler Trap - Hydro => Applies Wet to enemies and leaves a Hydro Puddle.
[*] Upgrade 2: Sprinkler Trap - Acid => Applies Acid to enemies and leaves an Acid Puddle.
[/list]
[*][h3]Rage[/h3]
[i]A new buff type for main character. Rage allows you to ignore stamina cost, take half damage and have 20 percent life steal on melee attacks for its duration.[/i]
[*][h3]Adrenal Pump Mutation[/h3]
[i]Now enters you in a Rage for 15 seconds when you kill 10 enemies with a melee weapon within 3 seconds.[/i]
[*][h3]Shoulder Cannon[/h3]
Shoulder Cannon now works with a cooldown rather than being once per wave.
[/list]

[h1]CRAFT UPDATES[/h1]

As per feedback, we realised melee weapons were not getting enough love. With these craft updates, we aimed to make them more viable with new conditions and abilities. 

Here are new "Melee Only" abilities that you can get :
[list]
[h3]Life Steal[/h3]
Heals you for a percentage of the damage you are dealing. Hitting multiple enemies do not increase the life steal amount.
[h3]Deadly Blow[/h3]
Deals damage equal to 25 percent of enemy's current health on given chance.
[h3]Culling Blow[/h3]
Directly kills enemies who are below 35 percent of their total health on a given chance.
[h3]Absorption [/h3]
Blocks a given flat amount from each physical attack after reductions.
[/list]

[h2]Triggers for several abilities[/h2]
Aside from those new abilities, we have added new triggers for some new abilities we have added to "all" weapons, as listed below:
[list]
[*][h3]On Charge[/h3]
Triggers when you activate your melee weapon's charge.
[*][h3]On Reload[/h3]
Triggers when you reload your ranged weapon. For Crank Gun, you need to fully reload your weapon to trigger.
[*][h3]On Dodge[/h3]
Triggers on landing after a dodge.
[*][h3]On Hoop[/h3]
Triggers when you initiate a hoop back.
[*][h3]On Acrobatics[/h3]
Triggers on landing after an acrobatic (climbing up & down, jumping across gaps).
[/list]

These triggers can occur only once per pre-determined cooldowns. When a trigger happens, you will see a cooldown icon on the left side of your Health Bar. Cooldowns are different for each trigger.

Triggers except "On Acrobatics", only occur if you are using the weapon (Melee/Range). On Acrobatics always occur regardless of your current weapon.

Effects that can occur after these triggers are:
[list]
[*][h3]Guaranteed Crit[/h3]
Your next attack within 5 seconds is a guaranteed critical hit.
[*][h3]Melee Buff[/h3]
Melee damage is increased by 35%
[*][h3]Ranged Buff[/h3]
Range damage is increased by 35%
[*][h3]Fire Explosion[/h3]
Releases a small fire explosion dealing 200 fire damage which can ignite.
[*][h3]Chill Explosion[/h3]
Releases a small chill explosion that applies Chill which can freeze.
[*][h3]Release Oil/Acid/Hydro Puddle[/h3]
Releases an oil/acid/hydro puddle sized at 3x3, which can interact with other abilities.
[*][h3]Shield[/h3]
Blocks a certain amount of damage, for 10 seconds or till depleted.
[*][h3]Release Bomb[/h3]
Releases an explosive bomb on the spot.
[*][h3]Release Cluster Bombs[/h3]
Releases small cluster bombs near the spot.
[/list]

Combination of these creates a large number of abilities you can get on the weapons. Weapons are not overloaded with all combinations possible, but rather with a theme. While Core Hammer type weapons would have more defensive oriented abilities, Alchemical Greatsword types would have more aggressive ones with higher chances.


[h1]New Consumable and Shoulder Cannon[/h1]
We have added a consumable item and a shoulder cannon to the game. We have added small separate menus for both shoulder cannon and consumable which can be accessed from Arma by clicking on the consumable and shoulder cannon. 

[h3]Freezing Blast Cannon[/h3]
[i]Applies Chill condition and possibly freezes enemies and other freezable objects, such as hydro puddles. [/i]

[h3]Rage Pellets[/h3]
[i]Small pellets that allows you to enter Rage for 15 seconds. [/i]


[h1]UI/UX CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] New cooldown icons have been added for each of the buffs you can get via items or skills above your skill bar.
[*] New cooldown icons have been added for the new ability triggers mentioned above.
[*] Visual effects on the main character has been added for the buffs.
[*] When you heal from a source aside from Life Steal, now your HP bar briefly flashes.
[*] When you enter an effect that allows you to ignore stamina, your Stamina bar freezes visually.
[*] When you get a Shield buff, a shield buffer appears on your HP bar.
[*] Your character flashes white when you are hit while having shield.
[*] Visuals of the puddles have been updated.
[*] Armored Arctic Swordsman has been given a visual uplift.
[*] New sound effects added for Crushing Blow, Deadly Blow and Culling Blow.
[/list]

[b]As we mentioned in earlier updates, localization for new updates are not present yet.[/b]
As these abilities are not finalised and may be subject to change with new updates and feedback, applying localization now will cost us as a small indie company. Also translating into 13 languages takes time which delays these updates further.

We hope you understand.


Have a blasting weekend and have fun scorching your enemies with new abilities !

notes.title: vEA_05a Ranged Weapons Update
notes.notes:
Hello PEOPLE !!

We coming in hot with a new update on ranged weapons. This took a while to build back-end stuff for the future updates.

But before patch notes we have an important announcement regarding localization.

To expedite the updates we will be making to the game, you may notice some gaps in the localization for a while. New texts will be available in English most of the part. 

The reason for that is, Localization updates takes quite awhile for us, and they cost us as well. We want to make swift updates, as well as want to try our new things when possible depending on the community feedback. 

But when you translate everything, even the things that might be removed or changed with next update, this takes both a huge time investment and financial investment. 

Hence, we will be updating languages other than English later on, and only when the updates are set in stone. Hope you people understand us.

Now, into the update:

[h1]RANGED WEAPONS UPDATE[/h1]

Each ranged weapon now can be crafted into 3 different versions, just like other items. If you already unlocked the recipes, you can go an craft them with no problem. Here are the weapons you can choose from : 


[list]
[*][b]Blunderbuss[/b] - Regular blunderbuss that you have used up to this point, only slight adjustments to its stats.

[*][b]Dragon Blunderbuss [/b]- A less powerful version of the regular blunderbuss that unleashes a powerful fire breath at close range at the top of its regular damage. Its pellets deal half of their damage in fire. This weapon can ignite oils and explosive gasses.

[*][b]Repeater Crossbow[/b] - Regular crossbow that you have used up to this point, only slight adjustments to its stats.

[*][b]Acidic Repeater Crossbow[/b] - Repeater crossbow that shoots acidic bolts, which apply Corraded to the enemies and deal half of its damage in Acid.

[*][b]Zeus Crank Gun[/b] - Crank gun that shoot electricity infused pellets, which deals half of its damage in Electricity.

[*][b]Bolt Gun[/b] - A powerful mini cannon powered by steam, shooting precise and powerful pellets with a faster reload time, at the cost of rate of fire.

With this update, overlapping qualities are removed from existing weapons (such as Fiery Rounds or Acidic Rounds) and these abilities will no longer come from randomised abilities.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - TEST YOUR METTLE!
notes.notes:
Hello people! 

This year we will be attending Gamescom with our game Castle of Alchemists. You can find us at the Hall 10.2 F030 ! And to celebrate that we are releasing a banger [b]soundtrack[/b] and a [b]huge update[/b]to go along with it!

Unleash the Power of Metal at Gamescom with "Castle of Alchemists" Soundtrack Pack! Get ready to rock your gaming world with 16 electrifying metal tracks that'll set the stage for epic battles and adrenaline-pumping action. Dive into the pixelated tough vibe and feel the energy of every riff and rhythm.

And for the patch here are the notes:

[h1]ENDLESS MODE[/h1]
We have brought in the Endless Mode with 3 map, one for each scroll! 

These are maps that already exist in the game. As we gather feedback from you people in feature updates Endless Mode maps will be unique.

Each map starts with a set amount of resources. As you survive, you will get a break each 5 waves and a small amount of resource. After awhile, no resources will be given for extra traps, however in endless mode you can sell your traps from full price in any moment.

Goal is not to win but to survive against ever escalating odds.

With endless mode, you can easily farm resources for crafting materials.

[h1]CRAFT REVAMP[/h1]
Previously, from a given recipe, you had a chance to get a different type of the said item, such getting an Electric Hammer from Blast Hammer recipe.

Now with the revamp, you can select which item type you want to craft from that recipe with a button located under the item visual in the crafting menu.

We are aware this makes some items less favourable, such as Explosive Bomb, when you can outright select the better Blinding Bomb version since it is no longer tied to chance. We are working on editing items on a greater depth, and will bring balancing in the upcoming updates.

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES[/h1]
[h2]Small Info Boxes[/h2]

In Craft Menu and Arma Menu, you can see the abilities of your experimental warfare in small info boxes now. 

Example: If your hammer has Crushing Blow Chance and Extra Core Capacity, small info boxes will appear on the sides to explain what is Crushing Blow and Core Capacity.

An important note is that this will only work for newly crafted items. Your existing items before this update will not show any info boxes.

You can go into compare mode by holding Alt key on keyboard or L3 key on controller. This is not arranged for a keybinding right now but will be as soon as possible.

[h2]Remaining Enemy Strength[/h2]

There is now an indicator of remaining enemy strength on the right of the screen now. This will bar fill at the beginning of the of the wave and will deplete as you kill enemies. Exact number of enemies will still be unknown.


[h2]Updated Minimap Visuals[/h2]

Enemy spawn points now flash when they enter and exit point flash if they managed to escape. 

Bannerman type of enemies have different icons and they flash on minimap as they start casting.
(Check enemy updates below for further details on Bannerman)

[h2]Enemy Health Bars[/h2]

Enemy health bars appear for 1.5 second on enemies when they take damage from Bellator melee or ranged attacks.

We are still working on controller support to give a better reading on enemies health bar without locking.

[h2]Damage Feedback[/h2]

A small visual feedback has been added when Bellator takes damage

[h1]NEW ENEMIES[/h1]

4 new enemies have been added to the Flame group, Armored Elites, Bannerman and a Spellcaster. These new enemies have been added to the existing maps.

Bannerman casting behaviour has been changed. Now as they spawn, after a certain amount of time, they will stop and start casting for around 12 seconds, applying their buff, approximately 10 times.

This means, if unchecked a single banner man can buff almost an entire sub-wave.

Number of Bannerman enemies have been reduced across boards. 

[h1]SFX AND MUSIC CHANGES[/h1]

Placement scene now has a subtle soundtrack.

Various SFX has been buffed up to be heard better.  Previously, some of the crucial SFX was difficult to hear among all other sounds and music.

[h1]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h1]

Repeated application of Chill condition now freezes enemies.


We eagerly await your feedback. We will rebalance and update as quickly as possible from now now, especially on the numerical part of the game.

Matching your previous level success or below, grants the half of the farm of that degree. Getting a better result gives you the full amount for the next degree of victories.

Previously, you needed to finish the level at Flawless to be able to farm it.

[*] [b]Challenges now provide extra resources when finished (8 / 2 / 1).[/b]

We are aware of the issue while earlier levels being way too hard for the new players, which do not allow a proper muscle memory build for the game, later stages ( especially 3rd scroll ) becomes way too easy. 

We made the first couple of levels easier with waves, especially till you open the crafting mechanics, and adjusted the waves for further levels at 3rd scroll to be more challenging. 

This balance change aims to improve the quality of the levels by the existing factors for now and  we are aware some of these maps require fundamental changes, with map updates.

notes.title: Weekly Update 22-05
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/e44f515fdc67acfcc4bca00e2a8a9f209f0d4f3f.gif[/img]

Hello everyone!

We have been working on improving the game feel and controls last week. Here is a rundown :

- Added a third attack to the melee attack combo, with slower recovery frames. 
- Final attack of the melee combo deals 1.5 of regular damage.
- Final attack of the melee has a larger area of effect.
- Stamina consumption has been added to the melee attacks. You cannot make an attack if you don't have enough stamina.
- Combo attack persistence have been added to melee attacks. (Character remembers his last attack up to a second, and performs next attack when the melee attack input comes. This allows several combos such as  Melee hit 1 - Hop Back - Melee Hit 2 - Dodge in - Melee hit 3).
- Melee attack damage have been increased 33% (90=>120).
- Enemies stagger longer when they have been hit by a melee attack.
         
With these changes we aim to make a melee attack become more dynamic for hardcore players, while still retaining simple approach for more casual ones. 

- Blunderbuss reload have been implemented.
- Blunderbuss pellet number has been increased from 8 to 14.
- Blunderbuss pellet damage have been increased from 25 to 30. 
- Blunderbuss reload animation can be cancelled with dodge, skills or weapon swaps.
- Added a new bullet effect Blunderbuss.
- Blunderbuss pellets now do not travel till they hit, it has a medium range (75 percent from mid to edge of screen, approximately).
        
We aim to make Blunderbuss a close-mid range weapon that can deal high damage.

We are aware of the situation this version of melee weapon and Blunderbuss can feel similar as both are for close range even though they have their own differences. As we add more weapons, we will return to solve the situation if it still persists.

As for the bugfix and backend improvements :
- First time you change direction with melee attacks did not hit before, this has been fixed.
- Sound effect of Training Button has been fixed.
- Stamina usage system have been revamped to include more actions, and be easier to modify.
- Pellet's visuals and colliders have been optimised to use less  processing power.


As what we are working on next:
- We are working on Level up system. We have tried various experience increment curves. And we have been adapting all maths to Unity. In this way , we have developed a level up simulation. Thus we can also check all possibility.

- We will add a poise system to the game, so not every hit from an enemy will interrupt you.

- We are working on new levels with their visuals.

That would be all for this week, cheers 👋

We have enabled our demo again for the festival, it has been updated and will stay a longer period of time. We will regularly update the demo with upcoming changes so stay tuned. 

Here are the update notes:

- War Room (Menu where you select levels) have been revamped with new animations, UI elements and a bigger area.
- Armamenterium Room (Menu where you equip and craft armaments) have been updated with animations. 
- Bellator now comes equipped with default items.
- Starting weapon has been changed to Blunderbuss. 
- Crank Gun is disabled for the demo. We will update it in the future.
- Main Base menu added to the game, with full animations. (You no longer directly go to Armamenterium).
- Training Area visuals have been changed.
- Library visuals have been added to the game, but mechanics are not implemented. We will use the Library Room for a compendium of enemies, weapons, equipment and lore.
- Several skills have been added to the game. Leveling up is disabled for the upcoming demo, but you will be able to see unlocked skill from the Mutation Chamber.
- A visual effect have been added for "Adrenaline Pump" skill when it occurs.

- 4 NPCs have been added to the game. 3 of them are functional and provide info about gameplay and lore.
- Enemies now drop their weapons when they die, purely for visual effects.
- New sounds have been added to the game.

- A small tutorial level has been added to the game, which plays only once and introduces basic movements and skill use.
- Melee attack animations now can be cancelled with dodge. 
- You can build defensive towers now. Only available tower right now is Ballista Tower. Towers can be build on elevated safe grounds, indicated via UI element. 
- Updated Fire Level 2 (Magma Reserves). Area where the lanes become parallel have been lengthened. We also added a Tower Platform, so you can now build a Ballista Tower in the level. Overall, difficulty of the level should have been decreased with the additions.
- Lava has been updated with shader effects, which can be observed Level 1 and Level 2.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41068993/e44f515fdc67acfcc4bca00e2a8a9f209f0d4f3f.gif[/img]


[b]Changes to reduce the difficulty of first 2 levels and improve overall gameplay : [/b]
- Fire Level 1 (Blacksmiths' Wing) rearranged the layout to make the choke point of the enemies further away from the exit.
- Fire Level 1 (Blacksmiths' Wing) Man Power increased.
- Fire level 2 (Magma Reserves) Man Power increased.
- Fire Level 1 (Blacksmiths' Wing) number of enemies have been increased, but their spawn rate adjusted. Flawless Victory conditions adjusted accordingly.
- Oriental Warrior and Oriental Slinger move speed reduced by %10 (5.5 to 4.95)
- Oriental Slinger damage is decreased by 30% (50 to 35)
- Enemies can no longer target you when you are jumping or climbing. ( Previously enemies would instantly know where you are going to land as you jump over or climb over obstacles, and would start their attack behaviour before you can react properly.) 
- Ceiling Dart Trap damage is reduced by 30% (50 to 35) and it's cooldown is reduced by 33% (15 seconds to 10). Ceiling Dart trap cannot hold a wave by its own now, but fires more frequently, thus combined with other traps it kills more enemies than before.

[b]Bug Fixes : [/b]
- Ghost placement of the traps have been fixed. ( Previously, on rare occasions, when you try to place a trap it would disable the area as if it was placed, but no trap would be placed and no resource would be spent )
- Losing ability to Dodge bug have been fixed. ( Previously, on rare occasions, you would lose your ability to dodge until you get damaged again )
- Being stuck on half movement speed have been fixed. (Previously, on rare occasions, you would stuck at half movement speed after firing )
- Going into negative numbers in Crafting Resources have been fixed. 

If you are interested about Castle of Alchemists and its development cycle, don' forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/xJM2D2CRyd]Discord[/url]
